about: The story of the first role. Points are experience and a level is reached at its points. Gear comes in parts, from the crates at drains, from finished jobs and one with every level. The parts fill one piece at a time, in the order of this file unless the player pins another piece. A finished piece opens something new to do, named here so that the app can ask for it by name, and nothing the game needs is locked behind a piece.

pieces.name: Boots
pieces.says: The map opens 110 m around you instead of 70 m.

pieces.name: Long coil
pieces.says: The detector reaches 300 m instead of 150 m.

pieces.name: Lamp
pieces.says: The landing patch pulses at the right moment.

pieces.name: High visibility vest
pieces.says: The nearby list shows five shadows instead of three.

pieces.name: Tuned coil
pieces.says: The detector shows how rare the nearest keeper is.

pieces.name: Field tablet
pieces.says: A drain's sheet shows the town's own card.

pieces.name: Survey wheel
pieces.says: A keeper that slipped away waits nearer, and you see which one it is.
